hook.name: SteakHouseV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that enforces per-band or time-based configurable LP fees across 8 MCAP bands, with per-band maxWallet and maxTx limits. Features an optional sniper tax (40–80%) for the first 12 seconds post-launch, a 24-second dev-buy window capped at 15% of supply, and an owner-managed volume-bot exemption whitelist that trades with 0% LP fee.
